verdict.rationale: Drata ships its own open-source workstation agent with read-only access to system preferences, used to check screensaver locking, password manager, antivirus and automatic updates. A community user confirms that employees in the corporate directory without the agent show up as noncompliant in the Drata dashboard, and the Devices API (custom-connection devices, apps per device) supports per-device tracking. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of disk-encryption checks, documented MDM integrations, and first-party docs on the per-employee compliance view.
